reproduction.description: Compare marginal independence with latent-class dependence on held-out four-category observations.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
Four-state synthetic data (240 train,120 test,9 variables) replace the ases4 survey benchmark.
K=1,2,3 mixtures replace K=1,5,10,20,40 and the categorical-FA suite; omitted models receive no invented score.
Missing cross entropy is bits per missing cell, not original bits divided by all test cells. Timing and multi-fold benchmarks are omitted.
